Reference Library

Past papers for CSCA reference

Download a free starter set of older university entrance papers and syllabuses. These files are useful for comparison and historical context, but they should not be presented as official current CSCA past papers.

Free downloads you can use right now

Use these files to compare older university entrance expectations with the current CSCA route. The strongest starting point is math, followed by multi-subject syllabus comparison.

Read this before you use the files

These downloads are older school-specific entrance papers or syllabuses. They are useful as reference and historical comparison materials.

Do not label these files as official current CSCA past papers. Use the current syllabus, practice sets, and mock packs for the main preparation route.

If you only want one starting point, begin with the older math papers and then compare them with the current CSCA math syllabus and math mock pack.
